fighters.name: Tortoise
fighters.author: jev-arena
fighters.tagline: Slow and steady. Lets you make the mistake.
fighters.strategy: I am a patient counter-puncher. I fight from next to a pillar and shoot bolts whenever I can see the enemy. The moment a heavy shot is on its way I raise my shield, then answer with more bolts. When the enemy is badly hurt I step out and finish it. When the zone closes I walk to the center and keep shooting.

actions.shield: My favorite move. Use it whenever a heavy shot or a volley of bolts is about to hit me.
actions.take_cover: Stay close to a pillar while the enemy is healthy.

reflexes.when: The enemy is charging a heavy shot, or a heavy shot is flying at me.
My health is low and a repair power-up is closer to me than to the enemy.

fighters.name: Sniper
fighters.author: jev-arena
fighters.tagline: If you can see me, it is already too late.
fighters.strategy: I keep my distance. I want the enemy at long range where my bolts land and theirs miss, so I strafe sideways while I shoot. If the enemy gets close, I retreat before they can punch me. When the enemy stands still or is stunned, I charge a heavy shot. I recharge only from behind a pillar.

actions.retreat: Back away whenever the enemy is close.
actions.charge: Only when the enemy is standing still, stunned or far away and not shooting at me.

reflexes.when: The enemy is close to me, within about 4 meters.
The enemy is stunned or standing still, and I have line of sight.
